transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

Well, I came in because the doctor who did my insurance physical recently said my weight was too low. I don't really see it, though. To me, I just look lean. I mean, I'm a painter, so I spend my whole day up and down on ladders and working long hours. It just seems normal to me, but they told me I needed to come in.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?

I mean... yeah, I guess I am. Like, if I have a client dinner or eat something with bread, and I see the scale go up even just a little bit, I get pretty tense. I usually start cutting back the next day just to make sure it doesn't stick.
Do you feel fat even though other people say you are too thin?

I wouldn't say I feel fat, exactly, but I definitely don't see what they see. It's more like... when I catch myself in a mirror, or if I see photos of myself standing next to one of my murals, I just really focus on my shape. I basically judge my whole day by whether my stomach and my face look sharp enough. If they don't look lean, it really bothers me.
Have you been deliberately eating less in order to keep your weight down?

Yeah, I suppose I do. Most days, I just keep it to coffee in the morning, and... maybe I'll have a protein bar between paint jobs. Then just a small dinner at night. I mean, eating a full meal during the day just feels like it would really slow me down, so it's easier to just keep it light. And it helps keep my weight where I want it.
Have you ever made yourself vomit after eating?
No, I've never done that. If I feel like I ate too much, I just cut back the next day like I mentioned. But making myself throw up... no, that's not something I do.
Has your weight gotten so low that a doctor has told you that you are significantly underweight for your height?

Yeah, actually, that's why I came in to see you. I had to do a physical recently for my insurance, and the doctor there told me my weight was too low for my height. I don't really see it that way, to be honest. To me, I just look lean from being up and down ladders and working long days. But yeah, he was the one who brought it up and said it was an issue.
Have you been trying to lose weight?

Well, it's not so much that I'm actively trying to lose more right now, but I definitely don't want to gain any. I mean, if the scale goes up even just a little bit... like after a dinner with a client or if I eat something with bread... I get pretty tense about it. So I just make sure to start cutting back the next day so the extra weight doesn't stick.
Have you been feeling physically weak or run-down from how little you eat?

No, I haven't really noticed anything like that. I mean, my job is pretty physical—moving ladders around, painting all day—so I get tired at the end of a shift, sure. But I wouldn't say I feel weak or run-down from what I eat. I feel fine, honestly. I always seem to have plenty of energy to get my work done.
What is your current height and weight?
I'm about 5'10", and last time I checked, I weighed around 125 pounds.
Have you been intentionally trying to keep your weight this low?

Yeah, I guess I do. I mean, most days I just keep it to coffee... maybe a protein bar between paint jobs, and then a small dinner later on. Honestly, eating a full meal just feels like it would slow me down too much while I'm working. So sticking to that routine keeps my weight where it is, and I just prefer it that way.
